title: Aerial Line and Ground Wire
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.
Setting: the narrow curved iron-and-stone catwalk with a rusted iron railing circling the brass lantern room at the top of a weathered cliffside stone lighthouse, high above a rocky ocean and sea spray. Time and weather: stormy overcast day returning, cold slate-blue and grey palette, gusting wind and rain, an eerie emerald glow from the sea.
Characters (keep exactly on-model): Penny, a fourteen-year-old girl with windblown auburn curls under a patterned headscarf, freckles, a heavy canvas mechanic's apron full of wrenches, pliers and gears, and a grease-stained linen rag; clever, practical, young-looking; the masked hero, a lean athletic acrobat in a rain-soaked, storm-grey and signal-orange weatherproof bodysuit with reflective silver safety-tape chevrons across the chest and limbs, a smooth brass-rimmed diving-style mask-helmet with two round amber lantern-glass eye lenses that narrow and widen expressively, a climbing harness, and brass winch gauntlets on both wrists that fire braided orange grapple cables tipped with small folding hooks; an enormous barnacled mechanical crab walker with glowing green conduits, iron claws, hissing hydraulic pistons and seaweed hanging from its armoured shell.
Camera: dynamic handheld-style move between Penny's hands and the hero's fight; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: Penny clamps a cable to the iron railing and runs it to a lightning rod, rigging a grounding circuit with fast, practised hands, while the masked hero swings out on a grapple cable and kicks aside a giant iron claw that sweeps over the catwalk.
No dialogue.
Sound: cable clamps, wrench clicks, whoosh of a giant claw, metal clang, wind.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
